text: Q: He is associated with the consolidation of a vast early imperial system stretching across three continents, brought together through a carefully organized system of provinces governed by appointed officials and connected by an extensive road network. His reign is marked by major administrative standardization, including taxation systems and imperial oversight across diverse regions. He is also identified by a monumental trilingual inscription carved high on a rock face, which not only proclaims his rise to power but also later became the key to deciphering one of the ancient world’s most important cuneiform scripts
daryush as the Iranians would say

Q: He presided over the greatest territorial extent of a long-standing Mediterranean empire, achieved through a series of highly organized military campaigns that pushed its boundaries to their maximum limits. His reign is also associated with large-scale public works in the imperial capital, including a vast forum complex built to commemorate his victories. He is also identified by a monumental spiral relief carved around a towering column, visually narrating his campaigns in remarkable detail from base to summit
